text_block_list.text: Don't hang around here chirping. Beat it.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Nooooo! I wanna race you, Brian! I even
wrote
you a letter challenging you to a
duel thingy!
text_block_list.name: Твин Турбо

text_block_list.text:
Is that what that was?! I couldn't read it,
the
spelling was so bad.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Gyah!
text_block_list.name: Твин Турбо

text_block_list.text:
Look at you, the very picture of fighting
spirit.
What has inspired this?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I lost to Brian earlier and I'm sooooo

disappointed!
text_block_list.name: Твин Турбо

text_block_list.text:
That's no reason to shoot an arrow with a
letter
on it at me. And then you come
barging into the
student council office...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
...I don't see the problem. Why not
accept the
challenge?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: What?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Unyielding in the face of struggle... As
one aims
for increasingly magnificent
heights, there will
never be a dearth of
insights to gain.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Yayyy! I don't really get it, but leeeet's
gooo!
text_block_list.name: Твин Турбо

text_block_list.text:
Geez... She doesn't even listen when
people are
talking. Guess I've got no
choice.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Raaaaah! Turbo boooost!
text_block_list.name: Твин Турбо

text_block_list.text:
(I suspected there was no thought put
into this,
but...)
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан
Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
(Why is that? Does she know no fear?
And this
running style is—)
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Huff, pant...
text_block_list.name: Твин Турбо

text_block_list.text: Waaaaahhh! I lost again!
text_block_list.name: Твин Турбо

text_block_list.text: ...You got a busted limiter or something?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Busted millimeter? Wh-what do you
mean?
text_block_list.name: Твин Турбо

text_block_list.text:
Did I do somethin' wrong? I was runnin'
as hard as
I could!
text_block_list.name: Твин Турбо

text_block_list.text:
...I bet. You sure broke the limits in a big
way.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: It was an interesting race. ...Thanks.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Uhhh... y-you're welcome?
text_block_list.name: Твин Турбо

text_block_list.text:
From that day forward, Нарита Брайан
polishes her
running style, making
herself into an even more
fearsome
opponent.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
